neet_phy_u09_t02_1.working: In an elastic collision the normal velocity component reverses from +v_x to -v_x. So |Δp| = mv_x - (-mv_x) = 2mv_x.

neet_phy_u09_t02_4.working: A is true: motion is isotropic, so the mean squares along x, y and z are equal and each is one third of the mean square speed. R is true as a kinetic theory assumption. However, A follows from isotropy, not from molecular size, so R does not explain A.

neet_phy_u09_t02_5.working: P = (1/3)nmv_rms^2. Doubling n and halving v_rms gives P' = 2 × (1/4)P = P/2, so the pressure halves and Statement I is incorrect. Statement II is correct: with no forces between collisions, a molecule moves uniformly in a straight line.
